caption: The video captures a beach at sunset, with layered orange, teal, and purple clouds and a small sun just above the horizon. A band of white surf breaks across the middle, its foamy lower edge continually wiggling, thickening, and thinning. The wet sand foreground mirrors the sky in broad orange and teal patches that shimmer as a thin water sheet moves. A curved foam tongue on the right deforms and shifts slightly, while a faint diagonal line in the left foreground changes position. A small dark foam remnant near the center gradually fades. The horizon, sun, and clouds remain essentially stationary throughout the visible segment. The visible sequence shows ongoing wave and water-edge motion without establishing a larger tide change.
